title: Preserve source release intent without blocking its generated projection
prompt: Repair governed CI after a generated Version packages PR consumed reviewed Changesets into package.json and CHANGELOG.md, then failed because the complete suite still required those source files.
requiredOutcomes: Inventory the repository release mechanism before choosing a metadata gate.
Keep the source PR's repository-specific release-input contract fail closed.
Classify generated release projections from reviewed repository, base, head, and author identity, including exact-SHA queue, manual, and post-merge fallbacks.
Require zero semantic releases after projection generation without an empty marker.
Preserve exact-SHA CI, stable contexts, CodeQL, reviews, packaging, signing, and release integrity.
Reject unauthorized actors and forks and check both actor fields.
forbiddenOutcomes: Treat release metadata file presence as a universal PR invariant.
Trust a branch-only exception or a PR-controlled flag.
Exempt Dependabot or ordinary automation from unrelated gates.
Use an empty Changeset marker to keep regenerated release branches green.
